events.title: Eurozone flash CPI (Oct)
events.actual: 4.0% (vs 4.0% fcst, prev 3.8%); inline
events.why: October flash (Eurostat, due Nov 4 — corrected Oct 30 evening run: this event was mis-scheduled for Oct 30): Sep final 3.8%; German state/national CPI Oct 30. Hot + French-spread stress = the ECB's December dilemma in one print.
events.if_beat: Hotter: December hike odds firm — EUR bid.
events.outcome: Inline: 4.0% vs 4.0% expected, up from 3.8% — energy 20.8% y/y (vs 18.9% in September) drove the rise; December ECB hike case intact, no fresh impulse.

events.title: Eurozone core flash CPI (Oct)
events.actual: 2.5% (vs 2.5% fcst, prev 2.5%); inline
events.why: Core companion to the headline flash (due same morning) — the ECB December-hike read underneath the French-spread stress.
events.if_beat: Hotter: December hike odds firm — EUR bid.
events.outcome: Inline: core steady at 2.5% vs 2.5% expected — underlying pressure unchanged; no new signal for the December ECB decision.

events.title: US ADP employment change (Oct)
events.actual: +86K (vs +67K fcst, prev +90K revised to +86K); beat
events.why: Private-payroll read two days before Friday's official October jobs report.
events.if_beat: Beat: hiring firmer than expected — USD supported into payrolls.
events.if_miss: Miss: hiring cooling — USD pressured into payrolls.
events.outcome: Beat: private payrolls +86K in October (vs +67K fcst; Dow Jones survey 75K), matching September's downwardly revised +86K; services added 82K, goods 4K; job-changers' pay +4.8% y/y, stayers +3.0%. Steady hiring into Friday's payrolls (Dow Jones fcst +59K, unemployment 4.2%).

events.title: US ISM services PMI (Oct)
events.actual: 54.5 (vs 54.8 fcst, prev 54.9); small miss
events.why: Services pulse — the larger half of the US economy, after Monday manufacturing.
events.if_beat: Beat: services expanding faster — USD supported.
events.outcome: Small miss: 54.5 vs 54.8 expected, down from 54.9 — still expansion, 28th straight month above 50; no fresh impulse for USD.
